content.title: Who Is Demi Lovato's Husband? All About Canadian Singer Jutes
content.text: Jordan Lutes and Demi Lovato in 2024. Credit : Stefanie Keenan/VF24/WireImage NEED TO KNOW Demi Lovato and Jutes were first linked in 2022The couple got engaged in December 2023Lovato and Jutes wed in May 2025 during a romantic ceremony in California Demi Lovato found her happily ever after with Jordan "Jutes" Lutes. The couple wed on May 25 in Santa Barbara, Calif., at Bellosguardo Foundation (Clark Estate). "[Demi has] never been happier. She truly loves Jordan. He’s amazing to her," a source told PEOPLE. Lovato and Jutes, who have been together since 2022, got engaged in December 2023. "You know, I've waited my whole life for him," the singer told PEOPLE in September 2024. "It's very grounding to have a partner that is so supportive, so loving, so caring. It's very easy to stay centered with him because I love him so much and he treats me so amazing." The "Confident" singer and Jutes were first linked after they were photographed holding hands ahead of the release of her eighth studio album, Holy Fvck. Here's everything to know about Demi Lovato's husband, Jutes. He's from Canada Jutes and Demi Lovato. Jutes Instagram Jutes originally hails from Ottawa, Canada. Per an interview with Nuance Magazine, he originally studied film and played basketball before developing a passion for songwriting while living in Toronto. He's an independent musician Demi Lovato and Jutes. Demi Lovato/Instagram Jutes was previously signed to Capitol Records but left the label "to pursue his own independent artist goals," per Nuance Magazine. "I left because due to Covid mad budgets got cut, and I guess they didn't want to hold me and not give me the support I needed, which is so blessed of them to do," he told the publication about his decision to part ways with Capitol Records after two years. "You hear about labels shelving people or holding them without pushing them so often, and I can't say how grateful I am that isn't me," he added. "I had been wishing I could be indie again for a while just because I love being totally in charge of my own career, so it worked out quite nicely." He co-wrote some of Lovato's songs Jutes and Demi Lovato. Jutes Instagram Jutes co-wrote Lovato's tracks "Substance," "Happy Ending" and "City of Angels" from her album Holy Fvck. "One of my fav songs i've ever worked on," he wrote in an Instagram post alongside a clip of Lovato's music video. "When i got asked to pull up and write for this session i remember thinking wtf am i supposed to do in a demi lovato session? only to show up and realize she was making one of the hardest rock projects i've ever heard," he continued. "obviously a crazy milestone for me but beyond that i feel so blessed to be a part of something i'm such a big fan of." In addition to co-writing some of Lovato's songs, it seems Jutes might inspire some love songs as well. In an April 2023 interview with CBS Mornings, the former Disney star spoke about returning to the emo genre for her album Holy Fvck, hinting that her next songs will likely be more upbeat. "I definitely am in a really good place," Lovato said. "I don't know what I'm going to write about on my next album because I'm so happy. It is a really good feeling, but I don't know what I'm going to do." She added: "Definitely a bunch of sappy love songs — for sure." He's been open about his sobriety journey Like Lovato, Jutes has been candid about his sobriety journey. In July 2022, he marked 100 days of being sober on Twitter. "Learning to cope with my anxiety properly was something i was always too scared to try," he wrote. "Took a long time to be ready but i've never felt better mentally and emotionally. if ur dealing with s--- rn that feels never ending just know nothing lasts forever." A source told PEOPLE that the pair have bonded over their sobriety journeys. "They joke, laugh, talk about their mutual personal problems, and what they overcame as young people in the music business," the insider said. "He is in awe of her talent and very supportive." He thinks Lovato is "gorgeous" Jutes and Demi Lovato. Jutes/Instagram In December 2022, Jutes gave his followers a life update on Instagram. He shared a carousel of images that included a cute mirror selfie with Lovato. "I'm still alive and my friends and gf are still looking absolutely gorgeous," Jutes captioned the post. Meanwhile, Lovato talked about Jutes' good looks in an episode of the podcast LadyGang. In a clip shared exclusively with PEOPLE, she recalled meeting Jutes while working on their 2022 album HOLY FVCK. “The way that I met my boyfriend was actually in a session,” Lovato said, explaining that he walked into the studio and she was immediately attracted to him. “I texted my friends and was like, ‘Oh my God, the hottest guy just walked In. I am so nervous. I don’t know what to do with myself,' ” she said. He and Lovato were friends before they started dating Jutes and Demi Lovato in 2023. Alex Goodlett/Getty During an interview on SiriusXM's The Morning Mash Up, Lovato revealed that she and Jutes were friends for several months before they started dating. "We're so happy," she said. "He's my best friend." He and Lovato made their red carpet debut in February 2023 Jutes and Demi Lovato in 2023. Jeff Kravitz/FilmMagic On Feb. 4, 2023, the couple made their red carpet debut at Clive Davis' Pre-Grammy Gala. Lovato wore a black-and-white gown by Rubin Singer, while Jutes looked like the perfect plus-one in a black suit and tie. "Turns out i remember how to tie my own tie," he captioned a series of images on Instagram, including a snapshot of the pair sharing a smooch on the red carpet. He and Lovato got engaged in December 2023 Lovato and Jutes got engaged during a "personal and intimate proposal" on Dec. 16, 2023. Afterward, the couple celebrated with their families at an L.A. restaurant. The musician later revealed that he proposed with a song he'd written. "I'm not a guitar player, but I can kind of play some chords. So it took me like a week just to write the chords for this song," Jutes said during an appearance on The Viall Files in October 2024, adding that he "almost broke down crying a few times" during the performance. Jutes popped the question with a custom pear-shaped diamond solitaire engagement ring designed by N.Y.C. luxury jewelry boutique Material Good. He and Lovato share a dog Demi Lovato with her dog Pickle. Demi Lovato/Instagram The couple share a small dog named Pickle. Lovato and Jutes welcomed their "new son" into the family in July 2024. He and Lovato wed in May 2025 Jutes and Demi Lovato in 2024. Chad Salvador/Variety via Getty Jutes and Lovato got married on May 25, 2025, at the Bellosguardo Foundation (Clark Estate) in Santa Barbara, Calif. “The wedding setting was pure magic — an oceanfront estate with sweeping views of the coastline," a source told PEOPLE. "Demi looked stunning. Mostly smiling, though there were a few emotional moments that clearly moved her.” Lovato walked down the aisle in a custom Vivienne Westwood gown "made with heavy silk satin fabric and featuring a corset bodice," per Vogue.
